A sweetheart of the Wise Old Man. With her love of combat she is ready to show just how mean she can be!

Quest: Love Story

Combat: During her onslaught, she teleports around to pedestals, and you should knock her off these in order to damage her. Watch out for her spawning fire. At least the Wise Old Man is there to help!
params.2102: Be prepared to meet your maker!
